newsitem.title: UK: Boots shares drop as UBS downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Boots shares drop as UBS downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Boots Co Plc dropped on Tuesday as analysts at UBS downgraded the stock from a "buy" to a "hold," dealers said.
Boots shares, which hit a record 708-3/4p in early trading today, were down 14-1/2p at 686-1/2 by 0925 GMT.

Dealers said UBS had highlighted the high rating of Boots after recent strong gains, with the stock trading at a 12 percent premium to the rest of the market at Monday's close on the basis of expected 1996 earnings.
"It has been a good performer over the past three months and they are just saying it is up with events," said one market source. Analysts at UBS declined comment.
